subject.title: Feature Request: Enterprise Analytics - Add Base Usage Status for OpenAI Business Team Subscription

question: Should CodexBar wait for a supported Business analytics API and implement aggregate workspace credits only, or accept an explicitly manual JSON/CSV import workflow?
rationale: The repository owner has established that current supported sources do not provide this data, while the two feasible paths have materially different freshness, privacy, authentication, and UX characteristics.

options.title: Wait for supported aggregate API
options.body: Implement aggregate workspace credit consumption and remaining budget only after a documented API/OAuth contract and sanitized response are available.

options.title: Accept manual export import
options.body: Add an explicit JSON/CSV importer with clear stale-data messaging if maintainers accept that it is not continuous menu-bar monitoring.

options.title: Decline unsupported integration
options.body: Keep Business analytics outside CodexBar rather than importing admin cookies or scraping private dashboard endpoints.

recommendation.title: Wait for supported aggregate API
recommendation.body: Implement aggregate workspace credit consumption and remaining budget only after a documented API/OAuth contract and sanitized response are available.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner already conducted the contract audit and framed the exact product and privacy decision.
